selection: Highest validation accuracy satisfying high-frequency recall >= max(original,tuned)+0.02 and macro F1 >= max(original,tuned). Otherwise report candidate as ineligible.
evaluation: Freeze all six choices before test. Compare all three versions on identical new respondents. No test-based retuning. No deployment if high-frequency recall or accuracy is worse than either prior model on final holdout.
limitations: New internal same-year holdout, not external validation; complete cases, unweighted US survey; concurrent associations, not future prediction.
